# `oaap app rehearse`

build a rehearsal: the test instance's code on a copy of production data (RFC-0030).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app rehearse [--name TO] [--code-from CODE_FROM]
                         [--from FROM_ARCHIVE] [--days DAYS] [--yes]
                         [--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT]
                         name
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | the PRODUCTION instance whose data is copied |
| `--name TO` | name of the new rehearsal instance, inside the same tenant |
| `--code-from CODE_FROM` | test instance whose retained package it runs (default: <instance>-test) |
| `--from FROM_ARCHIVE` | backup archive to take the data from (default: the newest one on this node) |
| `--days DAYS` | how long it lives (default 7) |
| `--yes` | carry it out after reading what it copies |
| `--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT` | tenant label: read the instance as a NAME inside this tenant (also: <tenant>/<name>) |
